question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the eligible voters cast their votes, 5% of the votes cast were declared invalid. A candidate got 10545 votes, which were 75% of the total valid votes. Find the total number of voters.
solution:
**Given:**

80% of the eligible voters cast their votes,

In which 5% were invalid and

10545 votes are 75% of total valid votes

**Calculations:**

Let Total eligible voters = z

Total casted votes = 80% of total eligible voters

Total casted votes = z × (80)/(100)

Total valid votes = 95% of total casted votes

Total valid votes = (95)/(100) × (80)/(100) × z

According to question,

10545 = 75% of total valid votes

⇒ 10545 = 75% of ( (95)/(100) × (80)/(100) × z)

⇒ 10545 = ((75)/(100)) × ((95)/(100)) × ((80)/(100)) × z

⇒ 10545 × 1000000 = 570,000 × z

z = Eligible voters = 18500

**∴ No. of eligible voters is 18,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Total votes = z

z × (80)/(100) × (95)/(100) × (75)/(100) = 10545

z = (10545 × 100times 100times 100)/(570,000) = 18500

∴ No. of eligible voters is 18,500.
